title: Server-side execution
description: What runs (potentially) on the server: Perform Script on Server, Execute FileMaker Data API and Install OnTimer Script (Step_ID-gated), plus the server-relevant Extended Privilege grants (fmrest, fmurlscript, fmodata, fmxml, fmphp, fmextscriptaccess). An access-audit view of the server surface.
author: fm-lab

params.name: file
params.description: Optional file filter (from the app-level filter).

params.name: mechanism
params.description: Restricts the detail list to a mechanism (Perform Script on Server / Execute FileMaker Data API / Install OnTimer Script). 'All' (or empty) lifts the filter.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of rows returned by the detail lists.
